crossRefs.note: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,
and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

people.name: Boaz
people.line: Kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”
translations.bsb: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”
translations.kjv: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel
translations.asv: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?
